scope: New wired IEMs sold in India at or under Rs 10,000; Type-C and 3.5mm ranked separately; sold-out kept unless discontinued.

formulas.harman_score: 100.08 - 8.5*SD - 6.80*|slope| - 3.48*mean_abs_error (error vs Harman IE target, 20 Hz-10 kHz)
formulas.harman_adjusted: harman_score - sqrt(24.4 / n_measurers); proxy -5; buyer beware = 25th percentile of measured (66.9)
formulas.hardware_frac: points share: detachable 9, mic 6, easy to drive 4 (3.5mm) or DSP/EQ app 6 (Type-C); unknown items imputed at the average rate
formulas.box_frac: points share: eartips 4, eartip variety 3, case 4, cable 2, adapter 2; unknown imputed at the average rate
formulas.value_score: percentile(score) - percentile(ln price), per plug, measured IEMs (in stock or sold out) in the top half by score only

key_numbers.harman_listener_split: about 72% prefer Harman-like tuning; about 28% prefer ~2 dB less bass and 1-2 dB more treble

sources.name: Olive, Welti & Khonsaripour, AES 2017 (papers 9840 / 9878)
sources.used_for: Harman in-ear preference model and target

sources.name: Squig-Rank (github.com/PEQHUB/Squig-Rank)
sources.used_for: per-measurement SD / slope / mean error from public squig.link databases (711-type couplers)

sources.name: Headphone Zone, The Audio Store, Concept Kart product feeds and pages
Judge.me and Reddit policies; store robots.txt files
sources.used_for: decisions on what not to collect

exclusions: Crinacle ranking list, squig.link lists, IEMRanking.com (robots.txt blocks Claude)
Reddit (bulk collection needs approval; research outside its programme not allowed)
Store star ratings and reviews (dropped: about 10% coverage, fake-review risk)
disclaimers: Specs, sound tags and box contents are as claimed by the store, not verified.
Rigs, eartips and insertion depth change measurements; treat +/-3 points as noise.
'Sold out, status unclear' items may in fact be discontinued; there is no stock history.
Raw frequency-response curves are not redistributed; only derived numbers, with credit to each measurer.
